description: Instantly boost your fly speed up to 500x faster with /flyspeed or using LCTRL + Scroll! Fly smoother, build faster, and explore like never before. All client-side and lag-free.
evidence: Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln 0.4.1 (28 classes, 26 members). Not run yet.

development.name: Flyspeed (Creative Flight)
development.statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
development.works: Holding Left Ctrl and turning the wheel while flying changes the flight speed, with "FlySpeed: N.Nx" above the hotbar, and Horizon's flight follows: 2 seconds of flight covered 26.5 blocks before, 37.1 after.
development.note: Not yet: the wheel also moves the hotbar, as Kiln can't stop Horizon's own wheel yet; the speed control works fully without it. /flyspeed wasn't tried.
